description: 행정안전부_생활안전지도 가스사고발생통계 [gas networks] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 행정안전부. 행정안전부에서 운영하는 생활안전지도 ( go. kr)에서 제공하는 가스사고 발생 통계정보로, - 지역별 가스사고 발생건수 및 피해 정보 등을 표시한 정보입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 행정안전부. Its tags are 가스사고, 피해현황, 물적피해, 인적피해, 피해지역. It offers 1 resource(s) in wms. The portal shows 2025-11-19 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
